title: Relative extension class of a torsor with a specified section
statement: Let X be a scheme, G and Q abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], P a G-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor], U an etale object and tau in P(U). Suppose 0 -> L --t--> Z_X --q--> Q -> 0 is short exact and natural additive equivalences Hom(L,A) = A(U) send t to the constant one. Then there is a unique beta in Ext^1(Q,G) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] represented by an extension 0 -> G --a--> E --b--> Q -> 0 with a natural map f:P -> E satisfying f(g+p)=f(p)+a(g), b(f(p))=q(1), and f(tau)=0. The one is the image of one under constant-presheaf sheafification at each object.

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free extension; Cartier proof (G1), complementary splitting

proof.text: Take the explicit free extension presentation E0 of P, and its short exact augmentation sequence. Use the sections equivalence to obtain h:L -> E0 with h corresponding to generator(tau). Naturality and the normalization of t show h followed by augmentation is t.

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free extension; Cartier proof (G1), complementary splitting

proof.text: Form E=coker(h). Compose G -> E0 with this quotient and descend E0 -> Z_X -> Q to E. Monicity of t makes G -> E monic: a kernel element lifts through h and then has t-image zero. The cokernel universal properties of both short exact sequences show E -> Q is the cokernel of G -> E, hence the new sequence is short exact. The generator map of P followed by the quotient is equivariant, lies over q(1), and sends tau to zero.

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free extension; Cartier proof (G1), complementary splitting

proof.text: For any competing model, the free presentation universal property gives E0 -> Eprime inducing its torsor map and the identity on G. Its projection to Q equals augmentation followed by q, by uniqueness on generators. The sections equivalence and fprime(tau)=0 imply this map kills h. It descends to E -> Eprime, a morphism of short exact sequences inducing identities on G and Q. Naturality of Ext classes identifies their degree-one classes, proving uniqueness. The proof remains valid for the zero source or an empty open.

theorem relative_extension_existsUnique (X : Scheme.{u})
    {G Q L : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}} (P : Torsor G)
    (U : X.Etale) (τ : P.sheaf.obj.obj (op U))
    (t : L ⟶ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))))
    (q : ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))) ⟶ Q) (htq : t ≫ q = 0)
    (hT : (ShortComplex.mk t q htq).ShortExact)
    (η : ∀ A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      (L ⟶ A) ≃+ A.obj.obj (op U))
    (hη : ∀ {A B} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : L ⟶ A),
      η B (g ≫ f) = f.hom.app (op U) (η A g))
    (hηt : η (((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))) t = (toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
      ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))).app (op U) ⟨1⟩) :
    ∃! β : Ext Q G 1, 
  ∃ (E : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (a : G ⟶ E) (b : E ⟶ Q)
    (hab : a ≫ b = 0) (hE : (ShortComplex.mk a b hab).ShortExact)
    (f : P.sheaf.obj ⟶ E.obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
    (∀ V g p, f.app V (P.vadd V g p) = (show E.obj.obj V from f.app V p) + a.hom.app V g) ∧
    (∀ V p, b.hom.app V (f.app V p) = q.hom.app V ((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
        ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))).app V ⟨1⟩)) ∧
    (show E.obj.obj (op U) from f.app (op U) τ) = 0 ∧ β = hE.extClass
